teams.synopsis: Back on top, dethroning MFGA — less about their own Week 11 and more that no other top team really did anything.
teams.blurb: After spending last week's rankings at 2nd, STD is back on top as they dethrone MFGA once again. Honestly, this placement is less about how the team produced in Week 11 and more the fact that no other top team really did anything. They're currently fighting for a top-2 seed with Grits. Playoff odds with a Week 12 loss: 98%-100%. With a win: 100%-100%. Current record: 7-4. Projected: 10-4.

teams.synopsis: A deserved drop after Week 11 — a primetime win over STD could reclaim the top spot next week.
teams.blurb: Do they deserve to move down after Week 11? I think so, but I wouldn't be shocked if the team wins in primetime against STD and reclaims their spot at the top of the rankings next week. Although their spot in the playoffs is clinched, they're competing with A$AP to secure a top-2 seed. Playoff odds with a Week 12 loss: 100%-100%. With a win: 100%-100%. Current record: 9-2. Projected: 11-3.

teams.synopsis: Clinched a playoff spot — the profile of a team that makes it and even the second round, but comes up just short.
teams.blurb: A$AP has clinched a spot in the 2025 playoffs. I think most of the league saw this one coming for at least a month now. This team kind of has that feeling where they'll make the playoffs and potentially the 2nd round but come up just short. Alas, anything can happen, so who knows. Tough final 3 games. Playoff odds with a Week 12 loss: 100%-100%. With a win: 100%-100%. Current record: 9-2. Projected: 11-3.

teams.synopsis: Playoff percentages look much better than the recent buzz would suggest — a Week 14 without Rico or Tet is the real worry.
teams.blurb: Based on the texts sent this week, you'd think RWB's playoff percentages would be much worse. I expect a win in Week 12 against TTF, even if London misses the game. Therefore, I think this team will have a fine time making playoffs, although that Week 14 matchup could be tough with no Rico or Tet. Playoff odds with a Week 12 loss: 18%-37%. With a win: 58%-79%. Current record: 5-6. Projected: 7-7.

teams.synopsis: Moved up despite an 84-point Week 11 loss — more about LP's injuries than anything Grits did.
teams.blurb: Despite the 84-point performance and the loss in Week 11, I decided to move Grits up this week. This decision was honestly more about LP's roster being wrecked by injuries, but I do think they should be respected as a worthy opponent when at full strength. Playoff odds with a Week 12 loss: 97%-100%. With a win: 100%-100%. Current record: 7-4. Projected: 8-6.

teams.synopsis: Nuked by injuries in Week 11 — getting JT and Olave back helps, but the playoff spot is already basically safe.
teams.blurb: LP's entire team seemed to be nuked in Week 11. The team will be getting JT and Olave back in Week 12, but losing Dobbins, Wilson, LaPorta, and Stroud/Fields is going to cause some pain and probably a loss or two in these final 3 weeks. Still, their spot is basically safe for the playoffs. Playoff odds with a Week 12 loss: 98%-100%. With a win: 100%-100%. Current record: 7-4. Projected: 8-6.

teams.synopsis: A rough two weeks continues, but this team should still be good enough to win once more with weak competition ahead.
teams.blurb: NY hasn't had the greatest past two weeks, and that may continue in Week 12 with Chase sidelined. Still, I think the team is good enough to win at least one matchup in the final three weeks, especially against relatively weak competition. All eyes on Week 12 against The Minutemen. Playoff odds with a Week 12 loss: 47%-68%. With a win: 87%-99%. Current record: 6-5. Projected: 7-7.

teams.synopsis: High playoff odds even with a Week 12 loss — confident this team finishes with a win in one of the next three games.
teams.blurb: Don't ask me why the playoff percentages are so high, especially with a loss in Week 12. Still, I have confidence that my team will be able to finish with a win in one of our next three games and claim a spot in the 2025 playoffs. Playoff odds with a Week 12 loss: 87%-97%. With a win: 99%-100%. Current record: 6-5. Projected: 7-7.

teams.synopsis: A believer until eliminated — the season likely comes down to the final week either way.
teams.blurb: I'm a believer, and I'll stay a believer until they're eliminated. I think TATY's season will come down to the final week of the season no matter what, but a win in Week 12 would surely help them out. Let's see if they can capitalize on a low-ranked opponent. Playoff odds with a Week 12 loss: 17%-40%. With a win: 56%-82%. Current record: 5-6. Projected: 6-8.

teams.synopsis: Not done yet — fighting to keep a perfect 5-year all-time playoff streak alive for a 6th season.
teams.blurb: They're not done just yet. The Minutemen have yet to miss the playoffs across the league's 5-year history, and the team is fighting to keep that streak alive for the 6th season. The injury to Jacobs will be important to monitor, but they have the handcuff, so the production should stay steady. Playoff odds with a Week 12 loss: 0%-3%. With a win: 12%-28%. Current record: 4-7. Projected: 6-8.

teams.synopsis: A shocking playoff push is still possible in the final three weeks — it all starts with a Week 12 win.
teams.blurb: I see a world in which this team shocks some people and makes a playoff push in the final three weeks of the season; however, it all starts with a win in Week 12. If Bucky can return this week, that would provide a much-needed boost, upping their chances at making playoffs. Playoff odds with a Week 12 loss: 0%-6%. With a win: 14%-35%. Current record: 4-7. Projected: 6-8.

teams.synopsis: Playoff hopes are technically still alive — injuries have really derailed what looked like a promising follow-up to 2024.
teams.blurb: Does this team have a case to be lower? Yes, but technically their playoff hopes are still alive, so I'll keep them at 12th. Injuries really derailed this franchise's '25 campaign after a successful regular season in 2024. Let's see if they can win in Week 12 and keep their playoff chances alive. Playoff odds with a Week 12 loss: 0%-1%. With a win: 5%-16%. Current record: 4-7. Projected: 4-10.

teams.synopsis: Eliminated from the playoffs, but there's still time to spoil someone else's season on the way out.
teams.blurb: Despite the team being eliminated from playoffs, I could still see them winning a couple of games in the final three weeks to avoid punishment and potentially ruin some other playoff hopeful's chances. Go ruin someone's season, but please don't be mine. Playoff odds with a Week 12 loss: 0%. With a win: 0%. Current record: 2-9. Projected: 4-10.

I think TTF will need at least one more win to avoid the 24-hour challenge, but I still think they finish in last. Every position except for QB and TE has been incredibly disappointing.
